THE FIRST ESCAPE

Chapter I · Night at the Palace

ကျောက်စာတိုင် · Bagan

By royal decree, soldiers search the palace for newborn princes. Princess Pyin Sa can barely walk. A May Mya holds baby King Kyan, while little Mg Kan follows the loyal guards through the shadows.

◆ VICTORY
Guide Princess Pyin Sa, A May Mya carrying King Kyan, and Mg Kan to the carriage exit in 20 turns.
◆ DEFEAT
Any protected character is captured, or the turn limit expires. Loyal guards may sacrifice themselves to save the family.
◆ STEALTH
Royal searchers threaten tiles within two steps. Hide behind pillars, wait for patrols, or throw a stone to lure patrols.
◆ CONTROLS
Tap a party member, then a blue tile to move. Mg Kan and each escort can move once and throw one stone per turn, in either order. Choose Throw Stone, then a gold tile. End Turn moves the guards.
